decisions.reason: The citrus-specific crate has a narrow market and only minimal web presence, suggesting limited option value; thus it is likely to be dropped.
The large foldable container had dedicated webpages in both years, indicating higher perceived potential and lower cost to keep, so keep.
Although stackable crates are standard, the product was only mentioned and has shown no strong signal, making its option value questionable; drop.
The rackable pallet is a commodity item with no distinctive promotion, so its option has likely low value; drop.
The spill-retention pallet targets safety/regulatory demand, and despite reduced web presence, the option may still be worth keeping; keep.
The load-retainer pallet had initial prominence, and the option may still have value in niche logistics; keep.
